metadata.description: Skills, subagents, MCP servers and CLI tools for Claude Code - built and used in production by p-zmud

plugins.name: audytor-prawny-marketing
plugins.description: Audits content against Polish and EU law before publication - ad disclosure, copyright and likeness, GDPR, terms of service, contests, regulated industries - and returns a verdict with every provision opened in the run

plugins.name: big-read-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that denies a full Read of a text file over 32 KB and points Claude at Grep plus ranged reads - images and PDFs exempt, an explicit offset or limit is the escape hatch

plugins.name: purelymail
plugins.description: pmail - stdlib-only Python CLI for Purelymail: mail over IMAP/SMTP plus account administration over API v0, with the skill that teaches Claude to drive it
